positions.notes: Stage 1: en «Online Stores» / ar «المتاجر». Termbase (de-estores 2026-10-09): «der Online-Shop» (confirmed), plural Online-Shops. Destination page h1 «Verzeichnis der Online-Shops aus Al-Ahsa …», cards «Shop besuchen», «Shops filtern». Stage 2: plural like the other bar names (Sehenswürdigkeiten · Veranstaltungen · Unterkünfte). «Shops» alone rejected: reads as physical shops next to «Souks»; «Onlineshops» (closed compound) rejected for consistency with the termbase hyphen form. «Online-Läden» rejected (not used on the page, sounds quaint). Stage 3: everyday German, no anglicism problem (Online-Shop is Duden-listed). Stage 4: Duden lemma «Onlineshop, Online-Shop» — both spellings valid; site uses the hyphen. Stage 5: capitalisation, hyphen U+002D, no trailing space.
